results.name: Both fixtures have 2,688 simulated hourly rows, four disjoint assets
Household H daily/week/four-week energy and cost
Household base: no change alert, continuous assets give no outside-use finding, no schedule/output prerequisite
Household change: TV +1,400 kWh (55,56%) qualifies under shared rule; site 16,100 kWh/Rp24.150
Industry I daily/week/four-week, Oven 50%, Sunday measured zero
Industry optional: schedule outside energy exactly zero; actual output 0,050 kWh/unit
Industry outside-window: +3,000 kWh, zero baseline, no percent; total 147/Rp220.500; energy change not alerted
Current-period scenario (21 Oktober 12.00): today and Monday-to-now
Virtual Monday 26 Oktober: "Hari ini" is empty (no future rows), not zero
Parent 10 kWh + child 1 kWh: never 11; each view valid
Alternative sources for one load: 2 kWh never 4; unresolved blocks the asset value
Unknown overlap refuses only the combined total; individual values remain
Average power 100 W for 30 min = 50 Wh; instantaneous power blocked
Counter 100 → 130 → 5 Wh with reset: 30 Wh valid, reset interval unknown
Overnight Monday 22.00–Tuesday 06.00: 10 kWh gives 8 inside / 2 outside
Interval 16.30–17.30 60 Wh, schedule ends 17.00: 30/30 estimated, conserved
Overlapping windows merge; shared minutes counted once
Half of an asset day missing: 50% coverage, recorded partial, no matched alert
Learning + no tariff + partial combination
All-zero readings with full coverage: valid 0, no percentages, no division error
Stale simulated source + client offline are separate facts; retry cannot fabricate a reading
Effective-dated tariff split: Rp3.000, not retroactive Rp4.000
Explicit zero tariff is valid Rp0; missing tariff is unknown
Zero/negative/missing output never yields intensity
Estimated partial output: complete days only unless windows + uniform confirmation
2/10 invalid needs acknowledgement and imports 8; 3/10 blocked; counts reconcile
Semicolon, decimal comma, quoted name with delimiter, BOM, CRLF, blank line
Bad header, impossible date, non-numeric value give actionable messages
One-row and irregular timestamp-only streams require explicit interval
Name limit 60 without silent truncation; row limit reported
Commit is atomic, retry is idempotent, interrupted result is looked up, reimport adds nothing
Composition: core-only keeps identical energy, rejects disabled capability at mock boundary
Feedback: hide/snooze/restore persists per revision and never touches readings
Rejected/expired settings save keeps confirmed values
Timezone change recomputes local-day boundaries without rewriting UTC readings
Simulated source setup retry reuses operation identity (no duplicate asset/binding)
